verbal_intervention.headline: MOF/BOJ pre-intervention channel RE-OPENS: FX rate-check + exchange-rate survey reported Sep 18 evening as yen fell through 157 - the classic operational tells; yen NARROWED LOSSES on the survey report

verbal_intervention.headline: Yen slides to 157.45-157.55 INTO Silver Week liquidity vacuum - fifth rise in six sessions, weakest-of-sequence extended; Tokyo shut through Sep-23 puts MOF 'maximum intervention alert' against an empty tape

A 157.55 print in holiday-thin liquidity is maximally trigger-happy geometry: no official selling possible, level keeps extending, and the intervention threshold zone is reached with nobody home to act. First Tokyo-open session (Thu Sep-24) is the re-pricing window - into a pre-announced airline-cutoff week.

convergence.methodology: raw_score = sum(imminence x impact) over tagged findings; convergence_score = min(100, round(raw x 0.17) + 5x(categories_beyond_2)); >=100 ACTIVE, >=50 DEVELOPING, else WATCH (formal layer). Hand layer (0-200 composite, confirmed-state rule) maintained separately in blackwatch-macro-event.json and untouched by this scan. De-escalation ticks carry no thread tags (v2.1).
